newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece cuts T-bills by 40 bps effective Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: Greece cuts T-bills by 40 bps effective Feb 24.

text.p: The Greek finance ministry cut gross interest rates on three-, six- and 12-month T-bills by 40 basis points to 9.4 percent, 9.7 percent and 10.5 percent respectively effective February 24 , it said in a statement.
The ministry will also cut the gross interest rate on its two-year zero-coupon bond by 20 basis points to 10.10 percent effective February 28.
Greece will issue 12-month and two-year zeros on February 28.
Interest income from government securities is subject to a 7.5 percent withholding tax for bonds issued from January 1.
